ellie-cs: Heads-up: Dynamo reserved-capacity bring-up scheduled Fri 09:00 PT for renewal QBR. Need quick checklist: quota, priming, autoscale, rollback. Aim: p95 < 350ms, cost delta < 12%.
raj-eng: I can pin pool-7 (3x A100) and confirm customer IPs. Do we want an initial KV seed?
ellie-cs: Yes — seed 8k tokens. Keep shadowing at 10% for 20m then ramp to full for 45m.
mina-ops: Run plan: 1) reserve pool + seed 8k 2) shadow 10% 20m 3) ramp 50% 15m 4) full 45m soak 5) 90m rollback window. I'll post run command and abort steps in the runbook.
sasha-sre: Autoscale suggestion: min=2, target_util=0.68, max=14. Enable batch_floor=6 and max_batch_ms=30. Add fallback to q4_0_small at p95>800ms for 2m.
ops-bot: autoscale policy applied to pool-7: {"min":2,"target_util":0.68,"max":14} :white_check_mark:
lee-data: I'll produce cost vs latency CSV and a short plot for the QBR. Will flag any >10% cost jump.
raj-eng: Whitelists applied to 18.52.32.0/26 and 18.52.33.0/26. Starting priming in ~8m.
ellie-cs: Great. Capture enablement notes (who joined, what docs shared) and send the 3-question survey after soak. If anything looks off, tag @sasha-sre immediately. :thumbsup:
